# Axiom ⋅ The Philosophy Society

> Axiom is the philosophy society at NSUT — fostering intellectual curiosity, critical thinking, and philosophical inquiry since 2017.

## Games

Interactive philosophy games built by the society.

- [Games](https://axiomnsut.in/games): Four interactive philosophy games — guess a term from clues, classify propositions, identify fallacies, and trace dialectical movements in the history of thought.
- [Hermeneutic](https://axiomnsut.in/games/hermeneutic): Guess the philosophical term from progressively revealing clues. Each wrong guess unveils another layer of context.
- [Époche](https://axiomnsut.in/games/epoche): Classify propositions across four philosophical axes: analytic or synthetic, a priori or a posteriori, necessary or contingent, descriptive or normative.
- [Fallacy](https://axiomnsut.in/games/fallacy): Identify the logical fallacy embedded in a philosophical argument. Wrong guesses reveal whether you're in the right family or class, narrowing the field.
- [Dialectics](https://axiomnsut.in/games/dialectics): A thesis is presented. First identify its historical antithesis, then select the synthesis that resolves the contradiction.
- [Negative Dialectics](https://axiomnsut.in/games/negative-dialectics): Dismantle a false historical synthesis by predicting its residual—the marginalized reality it represses or fails to capture.
- [Sorites](https://axiomnsut.in/games/sorites): Pick two colours, classify 34 patches across the gradient between them, and discover the Sorites paradox hiding in your own judgements.
- [The Repugnant Conclusion](https://axiomnsut.in/games/repugnant): Make a series of world-comparisons, each individually reasonable, to solve Parfit's "most important problem in ethics".
- [Philosophle](https://axiomnsut.in/games/philosophle): wordle, but for philosophy.
- [The Butterfly Job](https://axiomnsut.in/games/butterfly-job): Step into seven minor roles across the twentieth century and watch how tiny choices derail recorded history.
- [Fallacy Detective](https://axiomnsut.in/games/fallacy-detective): Highlight suspected sentences in real-world documents, name the fallacy, and close each case.
- [Philosopher Match](https://axiomnsut.in/games/philosopher-match): A philosophical quote is placed before you. Identify its author from four options, with hints.
- [Concept Map](https://axiomnsut.in/games/concept-map): Bridge two philosophical concepts via the shortest chain of directly related ideas.
- [Argument Reconstruction](https://axiomnsut.in/games/argument-reconstruction): Drag a philosopher's premises into their correct logical order.
- [Paradigm Shift](https://axiomnsut.in/games/paradigm-shift): Classify historical episodes in science according to Kuhn's five phases.
